local ambox_globe = "Ambox globe.svg"
local hour=tonumber(os.date("%k"))
if hour >= 22 or hour < 6 then
	ambox_globe = "Ambox globe Asia Australia.svg"
else
	if hour >= 14 and hour < 22 then
		ambox_globe = "Ambox globe Americas.svg"
	end
end
